in_sanskrit.name: चक्रवर्ती
in_sanskrit.meaning: Charioteer of the Universe, Ruler of the Wheel of Time
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who holds the wheel of the universe, the one who rules the wheel of time, the one who drives the chariot of the universe, the one who governs the cosmic order.

in_hindi.name: चक्रवर्ती
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who turns the wheel, the one who holds the wheel, the one who rules the wheel, the one who governs the cosmic order.

in_tamil.name: சக்ரவர்தி
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who holds the wheel of fortune, the one who rules the wheel of fortune.

in_telugu.name: చక్రవర్టి
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who holds the wheel of fortune, the one who rules the wheel of fortune.

in_marathi.name: Chakravartee
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Turning the wheel of dharma
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chakravartee हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chakravartee refers to one who turns the wheel of dharma, representing authority, leadership, and righteousness. In Hindu mythology, it is a title given to several deities and kings.

in_bengali.name: Chakravartee
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Turning the wheel of dharma
in_bengali.long_meaning: Chakravartee একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Chakravartee refers to one who turns the wheel of dharma, representing authority, leadership, and righteousness. In Hindu mythology, it is a title given to several deities and kings.
